title: 六下 · 社区与分工训练卷
scope: 存在句、所属关系、单复数与按条件提取信息；原创笔试能力训练。
language: There [[1]] a clean towel beside the sink.
a clean towel 是单数，存在句用 There is。
are 与这里的单数名词 towel 不一致。
am 不能与 There 这样搭配。
The room belongs to one teacher. It is the [[1]] room.
所属者是一位老师，单数名词后加 's。
teachers' 表示复数老师们的，不符合 one teacher。
teachers 是复数名词，未表示这里的所属关系。
The blue notebooks belong to us. They are [[1]].
空格后没有名词，名词性物主代词 ours 可独立使用。
our 后通常接名词，不能在这里独立作表语。
we 是主格，不表示这些笔记本属于我们。
Two [[1]] are waiting by the gate.
two 后需要复数，child 的不规则复数为 children。
child 是单数，不符合 two。
Our boxes are [[1]] the table, not under it.
句子明确排除 under；on the table 表在桌面上。
后半句 not under it 已排除桌下的位置。
during 表在某段时间内，不表示这里的空间位置。
Mia is number one in the line. She is the [[1]] student.
number one in the line 表排第一，需要序数词 first。
one 是数量一，不能这样接在 the 后表示排位。
three 是数量三，与 number one 不符。
These keys [[1]] mine. My keys are at home.
These keys 是复数，否定 be 用 are not。
is not 与复数主语不一致。
am not 应与 I 搭配，不与 These keys 搭配。
Please [[1]] the cups in this box.
请求或指令中用动词原形 put。
祈使句不把动词变成第三人称单数。
putting 不能独立作这里的祈使句谓语。

cloze.text: Our class has a box for sports things. It is 〔1〕_____ the door, so we can see it when we enter. Four 〔2〕_____ are in the box. We use them for the table-tennis game. A name card is 〔3〕_____ each bat. The card tells us who uses it. After a game, we put the bats 〔4〕_____ in the box. We do not leave them on the floor. The box is small, 〔5〕_____ it helps us keep the room tidy.
items: beside
inside
between
so we can see it when we enter
门边的位置符合进门就能看见的描述。
inside the door 表示在门的内部，不是这里的合理放置位置。
between 通常接两个对象；本句只提到门，用 beside the door 表示在门旁。
bats
cups
shoes
We use them for the table-tennis game.
乒乓球游戏要用球拍 bats。
cups 是杯子，不是后文 each bat 指的物品。
shoes 是鞋子，与后文的球拍不符。
on
during
because
The card tells us who uses it.
名卡附在球拍上，用 on 表示位置关系。
during 用于时间，不表示卡片附着的位置。
because 是连接原因的词，不能在这里表达位置。
back
off
over
We do not leave them on the floor.
运动后把球拍放回盒子，用 put ... back。
put ... off 不表示把物品放回原来的盒子。
这里需要 back 表示归还原处，over 不表达这一关系。
but
or
before
The box is small,
小盒子却有整理的帮助，两层意思形成转折。
or 表选择，原文不是在两个选项中作选择。
before 表在……之前，不能表达这里的转折关系。

reading.text:
COMMUNITY TABLE
There is a table for sharing useful things in our community room. Put clean notebooks and working pens on the left. Put small toys on the right. Do not leave food, clothes or broken things. The room is open from two to four on Saturday afternoon. Each visitor may choose one thing for free. You do not need to bring something before choosing. Please ask a helper if you cannot find a place for your things.
items: Where should small toys go?
On the right.
On the left.
In the food box.
Put small toys on the right.
玩具放右边。
左边留给干净笔记本和能用的笔。
这里不接收食物，也没有食物盒的安排。
Which item can be left on the table?
A working pen.
A broken toy.
A bag of bread.
Put clean notebooks and working pens on the left.
能用的笔属于明确接收的物品。
破损物品明确不接收。
食物明确不接收。
What may each visitor choose?
One free thing.
Two free things.
Anything after paying.
Each visitor may choose one thing for free.
每人可免费选一件。
原文限定 one，不是两件。
for free 表免费，不要求先付款。
Does a visitor have to bring something first?
No.
Yes, always.
Only clothes are accepted first.
You do not need to bring something before choosing.
原文明示不用先带物品才能选择。
always 与不必先带东西的规定矛盾。
衣服是不接收的物品，不是领取前提。

reading.text: There are two plants in our classroom. One is by the window, and the other is near the board. We have a job card for each day. On Monday, I check the soil. Lin checks it on Tuesday. We do not water a plant only because it is our turn. We look at the soil first. The card has a box for our notes. A tick means the soil is checked. It does not always mean the plant has water. This helps the next person understand the plant's needs.
items: What does a tick on the card mean?
The soil is checked.
Both plants have water.
The plant is near the board.
A tick means the soil is checked.
勾表示检查过土壤。
原文提醒勾不总意味着浇过水，更不是两盆都浇过。
位置与勾的含义无关。
What should students do before watering?
Look at the soil.
Move the board.
Wait for Friday.
We look at the soil first.
先看土壤再判断是否需浇水。
原文没有移动黑板的要求。
周五不是浇水前提。
Who checks the soil on Tuesday?
Lin.
The writer.
Every visitor.
Lin checks it on Tuesday.
周二轮到 Lin 检查。
作者负责周一，不是周二。
文中没有参观者检查的安排。
Why are there notes on the card?
To help the next person understand the plants' needs.
To choose a new classroom.
To show that every plant needs water every day.
This helps the next person understand the plant's needs.
记录帮助接手者了解植物需要。
没有重新选择教室的内容。
文中强调先检查再决定，不是每天必浇水。

task.text:
GAME HELPERS
Our board-game afternoon is on Sunday. Helpers arrive at one, before visitors come at two. Put the games on the round table. Keep the instruction cards beside each game. At four, count all the pieces before putting a game away. Tell Mr Wu if a piece is missing.
items: The game afternoon is on _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
Sunday
Our board-game afternoon is on Sunday.
活动日是周日。
Helpers arrive at _____ o'clock. 填阿拉伯数字。
Helpers arrive at one, before visitors come at two.
志愿者一点到；两点是访客到场时间。
Before putting a game away, _____ all the pieces. 从原文中填一个动词原形。
count
At four, count all the pieces before putting a game away.
收好游戏前要清点零件，使用动词原形 count。

writing.stem: 写一张约40—55词的英文便条，告诉同伴周日来帮忙整理游戏。说明13:00到社区活动室、带一支笔，并说明离开前要清点游戏零件。名字可虚构，不写真实联系方式。
writing.model:
Hi Jack,
Can you help with the games on Sunday? Please come to the community room at one in the afternoon and bring a pen. We can put the games on the tables together. Before we leave, we need to count all the pieces.
Thank you,
Mia
writing.organisation: 先提出邀请，再交代准备，最后提醒收尾任务。
writing.language: 检查时间、地点、名词复数和祈使句；不要把13:00写成14:00。
writing.format: 便条有合理称呼和结束语
writing.pitfall: 不要只写邀请，漏掉清点零件这一收尾要求。
